Item-level rights need to be checked otherwise (often indicated in the content description). Content with a CC BY-NC-ND license might not be reusable because of the "non-derivative" mention.

LEGAL_COMMENTS: Item-level rights need to be checked. Open acess doesn't mean open reuse. When specified, the license information can be indicated below the 'Acess to the document' or in the document itself. When there is no license information, the content should be considered under copyright.

LEGAL_COMMENTS: Item-level rights need to be checked. Open acess doesn't mean open reuse. When specified, the license information can be indicated below the 'Acess to the document' or in the document itself. When there is no license information, the content should be considered under copyright.

Content whose author is dead more than 70 years ago should fall outisde the scope of copyright and therefore be reusable (possibility to filter by date). Item-level rights need to be checked otherwise (often indicated in the content description). Content with a CC BY-NC-ND license might not be reusable because of the "non-derivative" mention.
